items.headline: New skins
items.text: Try Field Atlas day and night, Phosphor, wallpaper colours, or the editor to make your own.

items.headline: Stats pages
items.text: Swipe the top panel for Clock, battery, network, apps, sound, media, calendar, timers, messages and Notes.

items.headline: Messages page
items.text: Read and reply to chats right from your home screen.

items.headline: Focus modes
items.text: Hide distracting apps with Work or Sleep, with an emergency pass when you need them.

items.headline: Lock a folder
items.text: Hide private apps behind your fingerprint or PIN.

items.headline: Your own wallpaper
items.text: Pick any picture for the background.

items.headline: Springy motion
items.text: Menus, sheets and the stats card now open and settle with a soft spring.

items.headline: Hub on its own card
items.text: The stats hub sits on its own card, with tabs for Clock, Power, Focus and Notes.

items.headline: Arc settings
items.text: Choose how far the arcs spin, how much they bounce, how much they magnify, and which show.

items.headline: New skins
items.text: Moss, Glass and Graphite join the gallery.

items.headline: Dot-matrix numbers
items.text: Moss, Glass and Graphite draw the clock and battery numbers in dots.

items.headline: Figtree text
items.text: All words in Parc now use the Figtree font.

items.headline: Settings in seven pages
items.text: Seven clear pages, and search finds every setting.

items.headline: Same glass on both hubs
items.text: Glass now looks the same on the arc hub and the stats hub, in every skin.

items.headline: Dim works on your picture
items.text: Dim darkens a picture you chose, and the glass cards darken with it.

items.headline: Build stamp
items.text: Backup and about shows the version and build time.

items.headline: Better notes
items.text: View and edit modes, lists and formatting. A note can remind you or start a timer.

items.headline: Weather days and cities
items.text: In the Weather build: seven days with hours, better city search and up to six places.

items.headline: Longer periods
items.text: Network and Screen time switch between today, 7 days, 30 days, this year and all time.

items.headline: All time starts small
items.text: All time begins with what Android still remembered, then Parc keeps its own record.

items.headline: Drag to reorder
items.text: Hold a page tab and drag it to a new place. Settings has drag handles too.

items.headline: Six new pages
items.text: Today, Steps, Rhythm, Sky, Year and Lightly. Today is on; switch on the other five in Settings.

items.headline: Rhythm explains itself
items.text: The day ring now has hour labels, your screen-on time in the middle and a short legend.

items.headline: Today has labels
items.text: Each line says where it comes from. A quote fills the page when there is little to show.

items.headline: Hub pages settings
items.text: The list of pages is the first thing in Stats hub pages. Tap a page for its options.

items.headline: Hold to drag
items.text: A row moves only after you press and hold its handle, so scrolling is easy again.

items.headline: Swipe-up exit removed
items.text: Settings no longer closes with a swipe up. Use Back.

items.headline: Search modes
items.text: Search now has four modes: Apps, Translate, Note and Calculate. Pick one under the search box.

items.headline: Quick notes
items.text: Type a thought in search and save it as a note without opening anything else.

items.headline: Calculator
items.text: Calculate does sums right in search, including percentages such as 15% of 80.

items.headline: Records page
items.text: Your personal bests: most steps, least screen time and more. Off until you switch it on.

items.headline: Translation
items.text: In the internet build, Translate uses DeepL with your own free key. Nothing is sent until you type a phrase.

items.headline: Library
items.text: A shelf of the books you chose, with a Continue mark and a thin line showing how far you have read.

items.headline: Find books
items.text: Pick file types, search by name, and tick the files to show on the shelf. Reopen it any time to change them.

items.headline: Reader
items.text: EPUB and plain text open full screen in Parc's own reader, with page turns and your place kept.

items.headline: PDF too
items.text: PDFs open in the same reader, page by page or continuously, with zoom and dark pages.

items.headline: Open from other apps
items.text: Tap a PDF, EPUB or text file in another app and it opens in Parc without joining the library.

items.headline: Files in search
items.text: Search finds books by name and opens them. Translation history now stays on the phone, out of backups.

items.headline: Messages kept on your phone
items.text: WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram history keeps text and links, no images. You delete it; backups leave it out.

items.headline: Clearer replies
items.text: Reply is easy to find. If a message cannot be answered here, open its app. Search saved messages in History.

items.headline: Hide apps and folders
items.text: Hidden apps also leave Messages and Media. Hide a folder and its apps together; unhide them when you want.

items.headline: Clearer Focus
items.text: A chip shows the running mode. Focus hides messages from the apps it hides, unless you choose otherwise.

items.headline: Settings in five groups
items.text: Home, Appearance, Gestures & search, Notifications & Focus, and Data & about, with related choices together.

items.headline: Better text
items.text: Clearer labels, more readable text on cards, and matching headings in Settings and version notes.

items.headline: Books open again
items.text: Opening a book no longer crashes. The reader keeps your place, so you pick up where you left off.

items.headline: Find books remembers
items.text: Your folders and results are saved, so Find books opens quicker and refreshes in the background.

items.headline: Choose folders to scan
items.text: Pick the folders Parc may search, such as Download, Documents or Books. Only those are scanned.

items.headline: A clearer Find books
items.text: One compact filter, one search field, results grouped by folder, and a clear Add button.

items.headline: Add books from the shelf
items.text: A plus tile after the last book opens Find books. It is there on an empty shelf too.

items.headline: Small fixes
items.text: A few small fixes and quiet improvements across Parc.

items.headline: Reader keeps your place
items.text: Open a book again and it carries on where you stopped. PDFs keep your page and zoom too.

items.headline: Bookmarks and highlights
items.text: Bookmark pages and highlight passages. Use Add to Lightly to send a highlight on.

items.headline: Clearer notes
items.text: Notes now have titles, and the saved message tells you plainly that your note is safe.

items.headline: Year colours
items.text: The Year page uses clearer colours, so you can tell the weeks apart at a glance.

items.headline: Smoother library
items.text: Scrolling the library and the shelf no longer jumps or catches.

items.headline: Pages that belong together
items.text: Clock joins Today; System, Power and Network become Device; Sound joins Controls; Lightly becomes Commonplace.

items.headline: Arrange with a hold
items.text: Drag apps and folders, undo changes, lock the layout. Left hand mirrors Home; Remove leaves a + spot.

items.headline: Pages and search
items.text: Tap or scroll page names, hold for options, set a page size. Search adds icons, aliases, sections, Cyrillic.

items.headline: Today and notes
items.text: Today rows show an icon, a figure and a label, plus Continue reading. Notes gain search, share-in and undo.

items.headline: Library and reader
items.text: Shelves sort by rules, comics open, and the reader searches, changes light, defines, translates, reads aloud.

items.headline: Free, with a backup
items.text: Parc is free everywhere; internet only for Weather and Translate. Weekly backups run while charging and idle.

items.headline: Clearer hub pages
items.text: Today, Records and Rhythm now show a small label, a big number and a quiet date on every row.

items.headline: Library shelves
items.text: Shelves scroll sideways so you can reach every one, and sorting is a small button.

items.headline: Smaller search
items.text: Search in Notes and Commonplace is one slim line, so more passages fit.

items.headline: Easier to read
items.text: Labels are brighter on the glass, and More below no longer covers your text.

items.headline: Quizzes for your words
items.text: A 10-question quiz after each set, review of what you learnt, and an endless practice mode.

items.headline: Lessons
items.text: Short grammar lessons with practice that join your reviews. Easier to read.

items.headline: Year page
items.text: Add a date works again.

items.headline: Updates and downloads
items.text: Check for updates and fetch extra data from a private place. Easier to read.

items.headline: Better quiz answers

items.headline: Dictionary
items.text: Look a word up offline, in English or Portuguese, from the reader.

items.headline: Clearer lessons
items.text: Lessons show what you have done, with a calmer, tidier layout.

items.headline: Hear the words
items.text: Tap a speaker to hear words and example sentences.

items.headline: Deeper lessons: basics
items.text: Numbers, time, dates and phrases in full, with new practice every time.

items.headline: Deeper lessons: building
items.text: Articles, nouns and plurals in full, with new practice every time.

items.headline: Fixes
items.text: Small fixes and improvements. Easier to read.

items.headline: Your translation key
items.text: Your DeepL key now comes back with a restored backup.

items.headline: Protected backups
items.text: Choose a passphrase to encrypt your backups. Easier to read.

items.headline: New glass look
items.text: Calmer cards with frosted glass, one type scale and text that is easier to read.

items.headline: Redesigned Settings
items.text: Settings regrouped into six clear sections with quick tiles on top.

items.text: Settings is regrouped into clear sections, with quick tiles on top.

items.headline: Updates inside Parc
items.text: Parc can tell you when a new version is out and install it with one tap.

items.headline: Report a problem
items.text: Open a pre-filled bug report from About. Parc sends nothing itself.

items.headline: Encrypted weekly backups
items.text: Weekly backups now always need a passphrase and are never plain text.

items.headline: Easier to read
items.text: Short labels and larger touch targets that hold up at big font sizes.
